# GitHub 仓库 About 简介（定稿备份）

自认知外挂（cognition-exoskeleton）：我提供思路，由Kimi辅助我设计讨论，并创作的第一款大模型的认知灵魂外挂。完全独立于基础模型本身，不修改基础模型权重，通过外挂「认知模块 + 记忆模块」，让任何已训练模型获得持续自我学习能力。两级阈值 + 主人仲裁、防重复记忆、知识补丁。这只是个粗糙的版本，我会持续在这个方向更新。虽然我只是个不懂代码的小白，但这并不妨碍我热爱赛博未来。

EN: The first "cognitive soul" plug-in for LLMs — conceived by me, designed & built with Kimi. No weights touched; any trained model gains continuous self-learning via an external Cognitive + Memory Module. Two-tier thresholds, master arbitration, anti-duplicate memory, knowledge patches. A rough primitive — I keep iterating. A coding novice, but I love the cyber future.

## 附：英文完整版（供 README 或社区发帖使用，超出 About 字数限制）

cognition-exoskeleton（自认知外挂）: The first "cognitive soul" plug-in for large language models — conceived by me, and designed & built through ongoing discussions with Kimi as my collaborator. Completely independent of the base model itself: without modifying a single weight, it gives any already-trained model continuous self-learning ability, through an external Cognitive Module + Memory Module. Two-tier thresholds with master arbitration, anti-duplicate memory, and knowledge patches. This is just a rough primitive version — I will keep iterating in this direction. I may be a coding novice, but that won't stop me from loving the cyber future.
